name: Gasperlerhof
beschreibung:
Quietly nestled in Neustift im Stubaital, Gasperlerhof allows guests to experience traditional alpine farm life firsthand. Comfortable rooms and holiday flats adorned with timber accents offer a welcoming home base.

The Stubai Glacier, Elfer ski lifts, and picturesque walking trails are just a short ride away.
kurzbeschreibung: The Gasperlerhof farm in Neustift im Stubaital provides nature-inspired holidays on an authentic Tyrolean farmstead.
